table.name: vtiger_documenttemplates
table.sql: CREATE TABLE `vtiger_documenttemplates` ( `templateid` int(19) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `templatename` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `feature` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL, `description` text, `content` longtext, `version` int(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1', `isdefault` int(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `createdby` int(19) DEFAULT NULL, `updatedby` int(19) DEFAULT NULL, `createdtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL, `updatedtime` datetime DEFAULT NULL, `deleted` int(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (`templateid`), KEY `documenttemplates_feature_updatedtime_idx` (`feature`,`updatedtime`), KEY `documenttemplates_temlatename_idx` (`templatename`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8
